description.value:
As part of the action to cast this power, you make a ranged weapon attack against a target within your weapon's range, and the power fails if you don't. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and frigid air clings to the target, giving it 1 slowed level until the end of its turn.

At 5th level you add 1d6 cold damage to the attack; this bonus rises to 2d6 at 11th level and 3d6 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
